OnlyOffice.meta.name: OnlyOffice Editor
OnlyOffice.meta.title: OnlyOffice Editor
OnlyOffice.config.serverApiDesc: If the cloud storage server and OnlyOffice are deployed on the same server, this section can be left empty.
OnlyOffice.config.jwtOpenNoSecret: JWT is enabled; the JWT key cannot be empty.
OnlyOffice.config.jwtSecretDesc: Must exactly match the JWT secret configured in OnlyOffice Docs; leave empty to disable JWT.
OnlyOffice.config.jwtHeaderDesc: Header used by OnlyOffice for callback tokens; default: Authorization.
OnlyOffice.config.serverPortOpenDesc: Port 8001 is used by default; enable this to configure it and optionally combine it with the subdirectory
OnlyOffice.config.serverPathOpenDesc: Append the configured subdirectory; the standalone port is controlled separately
OnlyOffice.config.serverPathDesc: Used when the Office service address is empty; defaults to /office/
OnlyOffice.config.canCopyDesc: Enables copying of content in read-only mode.
OnlyOffice.config.canCoAuthoringDesc: After opening a plurality of people simultaneously open a file into a collaborative state, real-time synchronization of each person's state
OnlyOffice.config.chatDesc: Whether to open the left chat function
OnlyOffice.config.versionDesc: The default value is empty. You can add more if you update static resources or change the font.
OnlyOffice.config.debugDesc: Will write the log. <button class='btn btn-sm btn-default ml-20 view-log'>view log</button>
OnlyOffice.config.cdnPathDesc:
default is empty, unfamiliar do not fill;
if you want to migrate the office state resources to cdn, then configure the visit url after migrating officeData
OnlyOffice.config.kodAppHost: Internal network address of cloud storage
OnlyOffice.config.kodAppHostDesc:
The default field is empty; please do not fill it in if you are not familiar with it.
When the internal and external network architecture is complex, you can specify the internal network path for the Office server to access the cloud storage server.
OnlyOffice.config.docAppHostDesc:
The default field is empty; please do not fill it in if you are not familiar with it.
When the internal and external network architecture is complex, you can specify the internal network path for the cloud storage server to access the Office server.
OnlyOffice.config.interViewOpenDesc:
When accessing the cloud drive from an internal IP address, automatically open the file using the Office internal IP address;
The requirement is that clients in an intranet environment can access the above Office intranet address.
OnlyOffice.main.fileError: The file is corrupted (size=0), and cannot be previewed/edited!
OnlyOffice.check.title: Office running environment detection
OnlyOffice.check.chkDesc: Please check the following error information and try again after correct configuration!
OnlyOffice.check.chkDtl: The detailed detection results are as follows:
OnlyOffice.check.opt1desc: Access error, cannot use localhost, 127.0.0.1 and other local addresses; and server and office server must be http or https
OnlyOffice.check.opt4desc: Please check whether the office service in docker is started. If it has just started, you need to wait for 3~5 minutes;
OnlyOffice.check.opt5title: Office server gets from cloud (Office server requests server)
OnlyOffice.check.opt5desc: Request failed, please check whether the network is connected. address:
OnlyOffice.check.opt6title: Edit and save the file to cloud (cloud requests office server)
OnlyOffice.check.opt6desc: Request failed, please check whether the network is connected. Office address:
OnlyOffice.check.convertErr: The conversion service returned an error:
OnlyOffice.check.jwtHint: Please verify the JWT configuration: the "Enable JWT" switch and key in the plugin must be consistent with OnlyOffice Docs.
OnlyOffice.check.jwtMismatch: The plugin has JWT enabled, but the Office server is not validating JWT: Please turn off the plugin's JWT switch, or enable JWT on the Office server first and ensure the key is consistent.
OnlyOffice.check.jwtServerOnly: JWT verification is enabled on the Office server, but JWT is not enabled in the plugin: Please enable JWT in the plugin and enter the same key as on the server.
OnlyOffice.check.errDesc: Onlyoffice service abnormality, please contact the administrator!
